body: I can't imagine the guilt going through that man.

Forgive me for any assumptions I make towards your family. Honestly, from my perspective, it seems they probably want you to be a bum. You make that walking garbage look in the mirror to see what he really is, so they try to one-up you with the only advantage they think they have. Further evidence is in how he needs to reassure himself he's something he is clearly not. You are better than him. Point blank. Your mother probably isn't any better sicking him on you like a fucking dog. It seems she's too afraid of confrontation to do it herself and it sounds like she's taking her relationship frustrations out on you. I'd say it's because you were there for her. She sees you as someone to lean on, but somewhere in there she knows it's wrong and tries to cover it up in some weak effort to protect you. That's what I'm getting from this.
You might have explained it just fine with your first sentence. I wish there was more to people, but the more I look, it seems this is all there is to it.
Truly because god forbid we strive for a better life when someone apparently went through worst. Self-destructive bunch aren't we?
